notation_notes: Source strings beta or b in productivity/conditional-mark formulas denote the training magnitude rate. alpha in trigger settings denotes Mittag-Leffler order. They are different from an external source paper using beta for fractional order.
Both protocols retain trigger tau1day,alpha.5,spectral_step.4,spectral_tail_bound1e-8; source p1.3 is retained inactive serialization for the ML kernel, not an extra fitted shape parameter.
The stress-amplitude formula exp((.75log10)*(q-1)) is distinct from the temporal trigger density g(t).
Starts, exact-floor lineage, failure-only solver recovery and all mandatory-start completion rules are preserved verbatim as source settings; they do not certify global optimality.
Profiles and candidate forecast spreads are descriptive; no CIs/power claim. Heldout scores govern prespecified scientific continuation but never parameter selection.
Conditional stage2 fields describe an unexecuted plan only; they are not executed results or available fitted models.

productivity.beta_rule: A single training-only conditional-within-bin beta estimate is shared by all models in each case and remains fixed throughout all r searches/profiles/test scores.
productivity.bound_rationale: r=.95 provides fixed numerical distance from the divergent r=1 endpoint of the retained unbounded mark law. r=0 is an allowed one-sided optimum; upper-bound estimates are bound-limited. Neither boundary alone proves nonidentification. No bound expansion after results.
productivity.equal_mark_ridge: If all parent q=q0,trigger depends on n*kappa_r(q0); n2=n1*kappa_r1(q0)/kappa_r2(q0) gives identical fixed-history timing when both n remain admissible. Sparse profiles reoptimize n/background; no separate profile with n fixed is added.
productivity.feature_rule: Each objective evaluation must recompute all r-dependent parent amplitudes, event histories, compensators and,if E1 is run,class moments/Perron normalization from r-independent geometry. Editing only old cache metadata is forbidden.

higher_moments.formula: For m>0,r>=0,E[kappa_r(Q)^m]=(1-r)^m/(1-m*r),finite iff m*r<1; otherwise diverges under the retained unbounded Exponential mark law.
higher_moments.limitation: The retained r=.7 baseline and allowed r>=.5 lack finite productivity variance. This pilot uses finite conditional log scores and engineering controls,not iid-normal inference,branching-variance estimates,bootstrap coverage or asymptotic LRT. The .95 domain is a first-moment/numerical bound,not a finite-variance guarantee.
higher_moments.no_posthoc_family_change: Do not cap below.5 or taper marks after results; that would exclude the fixed.7 baseline/change the scientific family.

productivity.identification: At n=0, r has no timing effect and is unidentified. Report selected gradients, estimated-coordinate boundary hits and sparse profile support without global or confidence claims.
productivity.normalization: Under retained Q~Exp(beta), E[kappa_r(Q)]=1 for0<=r<1. For E0 with normalized temporal kernel,n is mean direct offspring; no immigrant-mean or physical branching interpretation automatically transferred to I0/E1.

profiles.ambiguity: max minus min held-out joint logscore among eligible near-training-equivalent candidates divided by n_test>.01 makes scientific robust gate false. Any unknown candidate score likewise blocks it.
profiles.candidate_forecast_rule: Score all full-search/nested/profile candidates within4e-4 of final training minimum on held-out window using their own frozen parameters; report range and r/n/background coordinates. Test scores never choose parameters.
profiles.completion: All4 prescribed starts at every node resolve. An unresolved node makes its primary free family unknown_profile_incomplete even if direct8-start search completed. No adaptive nodes or grid refinement.
profiles.descriptive_forecast_rule: Evaluate every completed profile-node optimum on both train and test coarse/fine caches and save its fixed parameters,train NLL,test timing/mark/joint scores and errors in a separate profile table (42points total). This is descriptive sensitivity,not candidate selection. Only near4e-4 final-training-equivalent pooled candidates govern the declared numerical forecast-ambiguity flag;2-nat support is not a confidence or predictive interval.
profiles.final_floor_admission: Eligible profile candidates enter final free-family training pool,with exact origin and source node/start; no further full-r solve. Original direct selected remains recorded. Apply I0free E0free floor only after final E0free profile admission.

I0 profile retains completed E0 profile optimum at SAME r with eta=0,and completed I0_fixed point only at r=.7. Fresh value/fine checks required; never reuse an old point evaluation after changing r.
profiles.parameter_constraints: Fix r to exact grid node,reoptimize other estimated coordinates with same bounds,solver and failure recovery. Fixed d remains fixed if applicable.
profiles.parameter_notes: Report whether r=.7 lies in sparse2-nat support,grid span,endpoint support,and n=0. Broad support does not itself constitute forecast ambiguity or force stopping if forecasts stable.
